KRISHNA RAISINGHANI
FOR COUNCIL

A CITY WE SHAPE TOGETHER

KRISHNA RAISINGHANI

FOR CITY OF NORTH VANCOUVER COUNCIL

North Vancouver is growing. I’m running to help ensure daily life gets better as we grow, with the right homes and infrastructure, safe and welcoming neighbourhoods, and a City Hall people can understand and trust.

Why I'm Running

Election Day: October 17, 2026

See My Priorities

North Vancouver shaped me.

I grew up on the North Shore, watched my parents build a small business near Lonsdale and 15th, and learned early how much local decisions matter in everyday life.

 

I’m running because the choices we make now will shape our city for decades.


I want North Vancouver to grow in a way that supports the people who live here, strengthens our neighbourhoods, and protects the sense of community that makes this place special.

MY EXPERIENCE

Local roots. Practical experience.

I combine deep North Shore roots, direct civic planning experience, and nearly two decades of professional leadership.

North Shore Roots

Growing up here, I understand this city as a resident, neighbour, family member, volunteer, and civic participant.

Civic Experience

As Chair of the City’s Advisory Planning Commission, I review housing and development proposals, consider how they fit within neighbourhoods and community needs, and work to balance different perspectives.

Professional Experience

I bring nearly two decades of experience in strategy, finance, and planning, including budgets, forecasts, risk, performance, and turning complex challenges into practical plans.

MY PRIORITIES

Practical priorities for a growing city

Three priorities guide my campaign: growth that works for people, safe and welcoming neighbourhoods, and a City Hall that listens, explains, and delivers.

Thoughtful Growth & Housing

The homes our community needs, supported by infrastructure that keeps pace and clear, thoughtful approvals.

Safe & Welcoming Neighbourhoods

Safer ways to get around, well-cared-for public spaces, vibrant local businesses, and appropriate support for a growing city.

A City Hall That Listens, Explains, and Delivers

Earlier engagement, clearer decisions, better service, and transparent reporting on progress and costs.

Read my Full Commitments

Building this campaign together

I’m honoured to have the support of neighbours, community leaders, local businesses, colleagues, and organizations representing working people.
 

I’ll also continue sharing clear explanations of the issues shaping North Vancouver and the actions I believe the City should take.
